original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚众议院调查NIPCO燃气许可证及NNPC高管洗钱指控
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚众议院石油资源（下游）委员会已就要求取消NIPCO公司在五个地点燃气分销许可证的请愿启动调查。该委员会指控尼日利亚国家石油公司下游业务执行副总裁Mumuni Dagazu洗钱和滥用职权。委员会还成立两个小组委员会进行初步调查，称这些投诉严重且需紧急处理。上述指控目前仅为委员会方面的说法，尚未得到证实。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚众议院石油资源（下游）委员会就取消NIPCO在五个地点燃气分销许可证的请愿启动调查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The House of Representatives Committee on Petroleum Resources (Downstream) has launched investigations into petitions seeking the cancellation of gas distribution licences held by NIPCO Plc in five locations.

key_facts.fact: 委员会指控NNPC下游业务执行副总裁Mumuni Dagazu洗钱和滥用职权
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the Committee accused the Executive Vice President (Downstream) of the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited, Dr Mumuni Dagazu, of money laundering and abuse of office.

key_facts.fact: 委员会成立两个小组委员会进行初步调查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Committee also constituted two sub-committees to conduct preliminary investigations into the petitions

key_facts.fact: 相关决定在阿布贾举行的下游周2026技术简报会上宣布
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The decision was announced on Monday in Abuja at the technical briefing marking the end of Downstream Week 2026.

uncertainties: 针对NNPC高管的洗钱和滥用职权指控仅为委员会方面的指控，尚未证实
请愿内容及许可证取消诉求的具体依据未在报道中详述
目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
